name: Yi-wei Muqin de Xinnian
source:
A Mother’s Chinese New Year is a visual novel where you play as a perfect woman who tries to satisfy her family during the Chinese New Year. The story focuses on the hardships of being a woman in a traditional Chinese family. You need to navigate your way through conversations and fulfill the role of a perfect woman: being a wife, a mistress, and a mother by keeping everyone happy during the holidays. But are all your sacrifices worth it?

[From [url=https://elsie-wang.itch.io/a-mothers-new-year]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《一位母親的新年》是一部視覺小說。你將扮演一位努力在春節期間讓家人滿意的「完美女性」。故事聚焦於女性在傳統中國家庭中面臨的艱難處境。你需要在各種對話中周旋，扮演好妻子、女主人和母親的角色，讓每個人都能開開心心地過節，成為一個完美的女人。可是，你付出的這一切，真的值得嗎？

[摘自[url=https://elsie-wang.itch.io/a-mothers-new-year]itch.io[/url]]
